audit.title: Outdated, high-friction lead capture
audit.description: When a homeowner or business lands on your site, they are forced to use a slow contact form. In 2026, buyers expect instant gratification. If they don't get an immediate response, they will message the next company on Google.
audit.fix: What we'll do: Deploy a frictionless WhatsApp widget and an AI-driven instant responder so leads get an immediate, human-like response 24/7. No lead goes cold.

audit.title: Bleeding high-margin residential market share
audit.description: Competitors like Manley Blinds are aggressively running ads on high-intent searches (e.g., 'patio blinds Nelspruit'). By not capturing these active searches, you are handing high-margin domestic jobs to inferior competitors.
audit.fix: What we'll do: Launch targeted Google Search Campaigns specifically for high-margin products (shadeports, patio blinds). We will out-bid the competition where it hurts them most.

audit.title: Unleveraged flawless reputation
audit.description: You have over 100 incredible 5-star reviews, but a new visitor to your site doesn't see them immediately. Trust is the currency of the internet, and right now, your trust signals are hidden.
audit.fix: What we'll do: Integrate live Google Review feeds directly above the fold on the new site. Instant social proof to instantly de-risk the purchase for the buyer.
